newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil falls on futures, premiums steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil falls on futures, premiums steady.

text.p: NWE gas oil edged down with benchmark IPE futures on Monday, but traders said premiums were little changed and the market was quiet.

On the cargo market, traders said although demand for German heating oil was fair buyers and sellers seemed distanced, with premiums put at Oct IPE +$7.50/+$9.0, cif Hamburg. On the low sulphur, a small cargo traded at Oct +$16.50, cif Bremen. Some traders said premiums could weaken slightly toward the end of the month with the arrival of a number of transatlantic cargoes.
So far, shipbrokers have reported that five vessels were fixed to carry gas oil from the U.S. to northern Europe and the Mediterranean, following last week's arbitrage opportunity.
One trader said he was holding onto his low sulphur material for the time being to see where premiums were headed.

On the barge market, falling outright prices did little to boost demand as sellers bumped up premiums -- second half Sept premiums were put at +$8.00/+$10.00 fob ARA. Traders said buyers were holding off in the hope futures would fall further.
